bazaar.notes: PC: two picks for each of the 11 requested states. Android preview rejected because stream chat covers play and the mobile feed is soft. No acceptable mobile picks in this handoff. Native game HUD, tooltips, build labels and two tutorial bubbles are retained.

ori.notes: Ten video frames across Blind Forest, its Definitive Edition and Will of the Wisps. Gameplay and cinematics are identified in each frame note.

battlegrounds.notes: 24 picks, two per requested state: one PC and one Android. Menu references show hero selection. Opponent-board references are explicit combat composition views; no separate scouting panel was present in the selected footage. Sources retain native HUD and notifications.

tft.notes: 24 picks, two per requested state. PC gameplay is a normal match (2024); Android footage is the native 2220×1080 client tutorial (2020), not a normal mobile match. Both menu references are Android client menus; the PC video starts inside a match. Opponent-board references show combat compositions on opposing arenas, not separate scouting panels. Native game HUD and the noted tutorial bubble are retained. Frames containing the later chat-head notification were rejected.

everdell.notes: Ten original stills: three official Steam digital-board screenshots and seven finished Everdell/Spirecrest illustrations from Andrew Bosley’s public site. Wide scenery 2, close characters 2, characters in the scene 3. Images retain original bytes and dimensions, with no cropping or upscaling. Publisher product pages returned HTTP 429, the old Starling URL 404 and ArtStation 403; no bypass was attempted. The artist gallery mixes projects; only explicitly identified Everdell art was selected.
